faq.q: What should I check before I post the photo?
faq.a: Check the finished photo against the item you sell. Make sure the shape, color, and details are accurate before posting.

faq.q: What do I get if I already have a supplier photo?
faq.a: You can turn a supplier photo into a fresh scene without booking a studio. Make several versions and keep the one that fits your store.

faq.q: Can I make a stack of photos, or connect the store I already run?
faq.a: Yes. Make photos for multiple products or connect your store through the API. This helps keep a consistent look across a large catalog.

faq.q: Can I add my price or logo on the photo?
faq.a: Yes. Add your logo or price after downloading, then check every word before posting. A clear product image can also work without text.

faq.q: What does a product photo generator do?
faq.a: It makes a new product image from a photo you upload. Change the background, lighting, or style without arranging another shoot.

faq.q: Can the photo become a video with a spoken line?
faq.a: Yes. Turn your product photo into a video with a voice and captions. A 6-second video costs 24 credits.

faq.q: Can I put the new photo on my product page?
faq.a: Yes. Download the photo for your product page, catalog, or ads. Make more scenes to show the same product in different ways.

faq.q: Can I post the photo on my store and in ads?
faq.a: Yes. Your watermark-free photo can go on your store or in paid ads. Use only source images you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: How do I turn a product photo into a scene I can post?
faq.a: Upload a clear photo and describe the scene you want. The tool places your product in that setting in minutes.

faq.q: Where do I find a template for the photo?
faq.a: Browse templates for product shots, lifestyle scenes, and ads. Add your product image and choose the background that fits your shop.

faq.q: How much does an AI product photo cost?
faq.a: One photo costs 24 credits. Starter costs $24.50 for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600.
